echoParts: She will give birth to a Son
and you are to give Him
because He will save His people
verseText: She will give birth to a Son, and you are to give Him the name Jesus, because He will save His people from their sins.
meaning: These are the words the angel said to Joseph in a dream. The angel was telling Joseph that Mary's baby would save the world from sin.
